note: Legal Freelance pipeline scrape, 7-day window. 10 boolean clusters run across Indeed/Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter/SimplyHired/Ladders indexed results plus Robert Half, MLA, Ropes & Gray, ACC Jobline and The Mom Project. Deduplicated against legal-freelance, daily, and pr-freelance reports back through 2026-06-03 (skipped repeat companies: aVenture, Tower Legal, Major Lindsey & Africa, Robert Half, Taylor Root, Latitude Legal, TraverseGC). Only leads scoring 55+ kept. 1 Grade A, 3 Grade B.

leads.notes: Combined 90, Grade A — strongest lead this run and the cleanest structural fit for a fractional fund-counsel operator. ACTION: apply directly through the Lawcruit portal; position Katie as a ready-to-bill funds attorney (LP/GP docs, side letters, subscription/closing work). Lowest-friction paid path of the four.
